baseline_missed_crater_diagnostics.crater_rank_definition: 1 + number of classes with strictly greater probability; ties may have rank 1 despite argmax choosing a lower class ID
baseline_missed_crater_diagnostics.ratio_definition: pwinner / max(pcrater, float32 tiny); threshold is necessary but equality is subject to argmax tie breaking
baseline_missed_crater_diagnostics.rank2_close_definition: Missed GT crater, crater rank 2, winner/crater probability ratio <= 1.1
baseline_missed_crater_diagnostics.pixel_example_policy: Deterministic first row-major match; at most 32 pixels, at most 2 per source image; illustrative, not a random population sample

crater_score_sweep.formula: Final crater probability *= gamma; four other class scores unchanged; then argmax
crater_score_sweep.implementation: After final resize: none adds log(gamma) to class-2 logits; TTA multiplies class-2 mean probability
crater_score_sweep.selection_rule: Among gammas improving both aggregate validation mIoU and crater IoU, maximize mIoU; ties prefer smaller gamma; otherwise 1

diagnostic_definition.corrected_regolith_to_crater_pixels: GT crater, baseline regolith, calibrated crater
diagnostic_definition.new_regolith_to_crater_false_pixels: GT regolith, baseline regolith, calibrated crater
diagnostic_definition.new_false_crater_on_gt_regolith_pixels: GT regolith, baseline any non-crater class, calibrated crater

crater_score_adjustment: Only final class-2 probability multiplied by gamma before argmax; one global factor
mountain_score_adjustment: Only mountain probability multiplied by alpha after final resize, before argmax; not a threshold
protocol: Independent scene confusion matrices, GT-present class mean; 1024 original + horizontal-flip score averaging; no label postprocessing
